title: Re-architected ticketing services for flash on-sales
summary: Lead engineer on a ticketing platform whose on-sales spiked from 350 to 10,000+ concurrent users. Re-architected the AWS service layer with JWT-based service allocation, tuned PostgreSQL with indexing, stored procedures and triggers, and moved order side-effects onto webhooks and transactional event processing.

scaleFacts.notes: Grew from 350 to 10,000+ concurrent users during high-demand on-sales; inventory is strictly finite and oversell is unacceptable.

highlights: Scaled ticket on-sales from 350 to 10,000+ concurrent users with JWT-based service allocation
Optimized PostgreSQL flows with indexing, stored procedures, triggers and transactional events
Built configurable dashboards for events, inventory and white-label partner workflows
Raised test coverage from near-zero to 70% across a 90,000+ line codebase

title: Media, collectibles and launch-day commerce at 10k+ concurrent
summary: Full-stack lead across a film-streaming and digital-collectibles platform: creator-to-fan media flows, digital ownership, reward-driven viewing, and production-critical token launch days. Backend services on cloud infrastructure with a document store, automated media operations with a vision API and vector search over a headless CMS.

scaleFacts.notes: Launch-day drops concentrate a day of traffic into minutes; media assets dominate storage and egress.

highlights: Architected backend services scaling media, collectibles and user-state workflows to 10,000+ concurrent users
Automated content operations with a vision API, vector search and CMS-driven metadata
Owned production-critical launch flows across UX, backend services and release operations

title: Configurable campaign workflows and E2E automation at scale
summary: Helped lead the frontend framework of an advertising-automation platform: extensible widgets and configurable UI workflows for campaign operations, plus an E2E automation program (browser regression across high-variation customer paths) that cut production bugs 50% and manual QA 60%.

scaleFacts.notes: Thousands of advertiser configurations; every workflow is a slightly different path through the same engine.

highlights: Architected extensible widgets and configurable UI workflows for campaign automation
Cut production bugs 50% and manual QA 60% with E2E automation and multimodal validation
Provided technical direction for 20+ engineers across architecture and testing strategy

title: Real-time risk dashboards over network infrastructure
summary: Built real-time risk dashboards with data-science teams to surface infrastructure exposure across a global payments network, reducing incidents by 30%+, and a real-time vendor portal that cut third-party approval cycles by 80%+.

scaleFacts.notes: Dashboards must stay current against a continuous event firehose while historical queries stay fast.

highlights: Surfaced infrastructure exposure across a global network, reducing incidents by 30%+
Cut third-party tool approval cycles by 80%+ with a real-time vendor portal

title: Agentic workflow engine compiling goals into DAGs
summary: A workflow engine that compiles goals into executable DAGs using LLM critics and evals, strict JSON schemas, beam search and MCP tooling — orchestration, retries, and evaluation harnesses for multi-agent workflows.

scaleFacts.notes: Long-running multi-step jobs with fallible steps; progress must survive worker crashes and retries must be safe.

highlights: Compiled goals into DAGs with LLM critics/evals and strict JSON schemas
Built retry-safe orchestration with beam search over candidate plans
